03 / MOLECULAR CARTOON

Recorded backbone geometry

Blue → gold traces the N → C direction. Smooth Cα cartoons retain recorded sites; no secondary-structure assignment is implied. Select a route to animate its representative conformation.

04 / INTERPRETATION

A–D are geometric clusters, ordered by radius of gyration. They are not established folded/unfolded macrostates.

128 runs selected in archive order from an adaptive-sampling dataset. Pooled occupancy is not an equilibrium free energy. XTC timestamps conflict with the depositor’s 50 ns run duration; analyses use frame indices. Nominal aggregate duration: 6.4 μs.

Source: Pérez Culubret & De Fabritiis, Chignolin Simulations, CC BY 4.0. CLN025 differs from original chignolin.
